notes.title: Localization & Gameplay Hotfix Rollout
notes.content:
Following our last major update, players experienced significant localization issues across various languages, excluding English, affecting nearly all aspects of the game, including notes. We've successfully addressed these problems, ensuring a smoother, more immersive experience for our global player base.

Additionally, we identified and corrected functionality issues with the archive's code panel and the behavior of a new monster, which, in certain scenarios, did not operate as intended. These fixes not only enhance gameplay but also contribute to a slight reduction in the game's overall file size, optimizing performance for players worldwide.

We're committed to continuously improving the game, and this hotfix is a testament to our dedication to quality and player satisfaction. Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: SCP-479: Lurking Shadows Update
notes.content:
[h1]Embark on a Newly Refined Nightmare: SCP-479's Colossal Update Has Arrived!
[/h1]

Hey there, fellow explorers of the unknown!

We're super excited (and a bit spooked) to share the biggest update ever for SCP-479: Shadows of the Mind. We've been toiling away in the shadows to bring this to you, and here's what's new:

[u]FPS Boost Extravaganza:[/u] Whether you're sneaking through corridors on a rig that's seen better days or you've got a beastly setup, enjoy up to triple the FPS for smoother scares. Plus, we've slashed the game's size from 23GB to just 15GB without skimping on the thrills. More room for your other indie favorites!

[u]Balanced to Perfection:[/u] We've tweaked the gameplay to enhance the challenge while keeping it fair. It's all about that sweet spot between fun and fright.

[u]New Scares to Spare:[/u] We’ve sprinkled in fresh horror moments that will make even the bravest hearts skip a beat.

[u]Flashlight 2.0:[/u] The trusty flashlight has been upgraded by the eggheads at SCP. Now, not only does it light your way, but its new features will help you fend off what lurks in the dark.

[u]Pause for Thought:[/u] Take a moment to breathe with our new pause feature when reading notes—because sometimes, you just need to take it all in (or catch your breath!).

[u]Rapid Reload:[/u] Caught in the dark? Hit 'R' to reload your flashlight in a flash and keep those shadows at bay.

[u]Quick Mental Mend:[/u] Your mind fraying at the edges? Tap 'Q' for a quick sanity boost and stay sharp amid the chaos.

[u]Bug Squashing:[/u] We’ve ironed out those pesky bugs that haunted your gameplay, providing a smoother and more immersive experience.

This is just a peek into the abyss. We've got a lot more eerie surprises tucked away in the shadows for you to discover. We're a tiny team with a big dream, and every scare, every tense moment, and every whispered lore is crafted with our love for horror and dedication to our players.

So, what are you waiting for?

P.S. By the way, we have added tentacles.

notes.title: Major Game Update - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, SCP-479 players!

We're thrilled to announce a significant update that's now available for download. Here's a breakdown of what to expect:

[u]Key Randomization:[/u]
Keys will often be in different locations within the same rooms. However, some remain static to ensure the game isn't overly complicated.

[u]Resource Randomization:[/u]
Each new game will have varied amounts and locations for resources. Expect an average of 30 medicines and 45 batteries in a typical playthrough.

[u]Archive's Code Randomization:[/u]
Every playthrough will have a unique code for the archive. Can you guess it?

[u]New Horror Moments:[/u]
More scares added for an intensified experience. We won't spoil the details, though!

[u]Complete Balance Overhaul:[/u]
We've worked on ensuring the game remains engaging, challenging, yet not too daunting for beginners.

[u]Enhanced Control Friendliness:[/u]
Picking up batteries now auto-loads them into the flashlight if needed. Doors unlock and open with fewer clicks. Plus, some other quality-of-life improvements.

[u]Gamma Settings:[/u]
Adjust brightness and contrast on-the-fly from the settings. If the game seems too dark, tweak the gamma for a more personalized experience.

[u]Steam Achievements:[/u]
Four new achievements have been added to reward your progress!

[u]Optimization Improvement:[/u]
Enhanced for smoother gameplay.

[u]Partial Controller Support:[/u]
Though we can't guarantee compatibility with all gamepads, we've introduced some support. We recommend keyboard and mouse for optimal precision.

Thank you for your continued support! We hope these changes enhance your SCP-479 experience. As always, your feedback is invaluable.

notes.title: SCP-479: Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 
We are working diligently to ensure that this major update will significantly enhance the gaming experience for all players, addressing both the gameplay balance and the user interface, and potentially introducing new content and features. 

[h2]Confirmed Features:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] [b]Key Randomization:[/b]
Although they will be located in the same rooms, they will now be found in different places within the room.
[*] [b]Resource Randomization:[/b]
The amount and location of resources (batteries and medicines) will change every time you start a new game.
[*] [b]Archive's Code Randomization[/b]
[*] [b]New Horror Moments:[/b]
To scare you more often.
[*] [b]Complete Balance Overhaul:[/b]
We aim to make the game engaging for everyone and will try to avoid situations where it’s too difficult for beginners and too easy and boring on the second or third playthrough.
[*] [b]Enhanced Control Friendliness:[/b]
For more intuitive and user-friendly gameplay.
[*] [b]Gamma Settings:[/b]
This will allow every user to adjust the brightness and contrast to suit their specific monitor, addressing mainly the "game is too dark" issue and avoiding the need to manually recalibrate the monitor for the game.
[/olist]

[h2]Desired but Uncertain Features:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]New Enemies:[/b]
To increase diversity and unpredictability.
[*] [b]Additional Localizations:[/b]
Primarily Korean. Initially, we planned to support around 16 languages, but we had to abandon half of them at the last moment due to a bug. We hope to fix it as the translations are ready.
[*] [b]Steam Achievements:[/b]
To reward progress and accomplishments within the game.
[*] [b]Optimization Improvement:[/b]
To ensure smoother gameplay and enhanced performance.
[/olist]


We aim to fulfill both our confirmed and desired objectives, although the latter is subject to time and technical constraints. We appreciate your patience and support as we work towards refining and expanding our game.

Release Date: [b]October 2023[/b]

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We’ve squashed several minor bugs to ensure smoother gameplay.

[b]Enhanced Door Access[/b]: For added convenience, doors can now be opened with both LMB and RMB, provided you have the key.

[b]Noticeable Security Point Key[/b]: We’ve made the key to the security point more prominent to aid your progression.

[b]Additional Battery[/b]: We’ve placed an extra battery near the flashlight, keeping you illuminated for longer.

[b]Localization Fix[/b]: The absence of Russian localization in the description of flashlight batteries has been rectified.

We are committed to continually enhancing your experience and are eager to hear your thoughts on these updates. Dive back into the shadows and experience these improvements firsthand! Enjoy the heightened immersion, and as always, stay safe in the shadows! 🌒

notes.title: Patch 1 for SCP-479: Shadows of the Mind!
notes.content:
We've noticed the gameplay may be a tad challenging due to the hidden mechanics that require some time to decipher. So, we are making several balance enhancements to provide a smoother, more enjoyable gaming experience for all players!

[b]What's New in Patch 1:[/b]
- [b]Improved Balance:[/b] Medications will now restore more sanity on average.
- [b]Extended Flashlight Duration:[/b] The flashlight will now last longer, allowing players more time to explore and uncover the game's mysteries.

Additionally, the patch will feature refinements to the Russian localization to deliver the best gaming experience for our Russian-speaking players.

We made these adjustments to give players more leeway in grasping the intricate mechanics embedded within the game and to accommodate diverse playing styles and preferences.

Please share your feedback and let us know how these changes have affected your gaming experience after updating the game! We are continually aiming to enhance and optimize SCP-479: Shadows of the Mind to meet your expectations and deliver a thrilling horror adventure.

Stay tuned for more updates and enhancements! And as always, happy gaming!
